rules: 1. After the existing float expect.addSnapshotSerializer in packages/excalidraw/tests/test-utils.ts (around line 285), register an expect.addSnapshotSerializer whose test(val) returns true when val is a non-null plain object containing "activePageId", "pages", "pageViewports", and "selectedElementIds", and whose serialize omits pages, activePageId, and pageViewports before delegating to printer.

behaviour: Verify multi-page creation, switching, active-page rendering and selection isolation, per-page viewport persistence, page rename/reorder/delete and single-page guard, page-scoped undo/redo, active-page visual export vs multi-page JSON serialization, legacy and multi-page restore, and cross-page search navigation.
rules: 1. Render <Excalidraw /> via render from ./test-utils and test all acceptance criteria AC-1 through AC-7 using window.h, API, fireEvent, and waitFor.

2. Cover AC-1: create elements on Page 1, add Page 2, create distinct elements on Page 2, switch between Page 1 and Page 2, and assert h.app.scene.getNonDeletedElements() returns only the active page's elements and selecting all only selects active-page elements.

3. Cover AC-2: set non-default scrollX, scrollY, zoom and selectedElementIds on Page 1, switch to Page 2 and set different scrollX, scrollY, zoom, switch back to Page 1 and assert Page 1's viewport is restored, Page 2's viewport is restored when switching back, and selectedElementIds is cleared on page switch.

4. Cover AC-3: rename a page via PageTabs inline rename input / renamePage to "SDK flow", reorder pages via reorderPages / move buttons, delete a page when multiple pages exist (confirming via ConfirmDialog when triggered from UI) and verify its elements are tombstoned (isDeleted: true with incremented version in getAllSceneElementsIncludingDeleted() and absent from getAllSceneElements()) and activePageId transitions to a remaining page, and verify deleting the last remaining page is prevented/disabled.

5. Cover AC-4: create rect1 on Page 1, switch to Page 2, create rect2 on Page 2, execute undo on Page 2 and assert rect2 is undone while activePageId stays Page 2 and rect1 on Page 1 remains intact, then switch to Page 1 and undo rect1 without affecting Page 2.

6. Cover AC-5: create elements on Page 1 and Page 2, assert exportScene({ type: "svg", data: { elements: h.app.getAllSceneElements(), appState: h.state, files: h.app.files } }) renders only the active page's elements, and assert serializeAsJSON (for both "local" and "database" targets) serializes both pages and their elements in one JSON payload.

7. Cover AC-6: verify restore / restoreAppState / restoreElements on a legacy single-page payload (without pages/activePageId/pageId) creates one default page and assigns all elements to it, and on a multi-page payload restores all pages in order, their names, per-page viewports, and each page's elements.

8. Cover AC-7: create a text element on Page 1 and a text element "PipelineNode" on Page 2, open SearchMenu while on Page 1, search for "PipelineNode", click/select the match, and assert activePageId switches to Page 2.

style_from.reason: Follow Excalidraw Vitest jsdom test conventions, imports, and render/API usage.

uses.reason: Reference SearchMenu DOM structure and input/result selectors for AC-7.

tests.name: AC-1: creates and switches pages with isolated active-page elements and selection
tests.given: Elements created on Page 1 and Page 2 in Excalidraw
tests.expect: scene.getNonDeletedElements() and selection actions only return/select the active page's elements while getAllSceneElements() returns elements from both pages

tests.name: AC-2: preserves independent per-page viewport state and clears selection on page switch
tests.given: Distinct scrollX, scrollY, zoom on Page 1 and Page 2 and a selected element on Page 1
tests.expect: Switching between Page 1 and Page 2 saves and restores each page's scrollX, scrollY, and zoom and resets selectedElementIds to {}

tests.name: AC-3: renames, reorders, and deletes pages via PageTabs and prevents deleting the last page
tests.given: Multiple pages in the page tab bar
tests.expect: Inline rename updates page name, reorder updates page order, delete tombstones the page's elements with bumped version after confirmation and switches activePageId, and delete button is disabled when only 1 page remains

tests.name: AC-4: isolates undo and redo history per page
tests.given: rect1 created on Page 1 and rect2 created on Page 2
tests.expect: Undoing on Page 2 removes rect2 while staying on Page 2 and keeping rect1 on Page 1; switching to Page 1 and undoing removes rect1 without affecting Page 2

tests.name: AC-5: exports only active page visually in exportScene while serializeAsJSON includes all pages for local and database targets
tests.given: Elements on Page 1 and Page 2 with Page 1 active
tests.expect: exportScene SVG output contains only Page 1 elements whereas serializeAsJSON output (local and database) contains both pages and all elements from Page 1 and Page 2

tests.name: AC-6: restores legacy single-page files onto a default page and restores multi-page files completely
tests.given: A legacy single-page JSON payload without page fields and a multi-page JSON payload
tests.expect: Legacy payload restores with 1 default page as activePageId and all elements on that page; multi-page payload restores all pages, names, viewports, and page elements

tests.name: AC-7: searches across all pages in SearchMenu and switches to the matched element's page
tests.given: Text on Page 1 and text 'PipelineNode' on Page 2 while Page 1 is active
tests.expect: Searching 'PipelineNode' in SearchMenu finds the match on Page 2 and clicking the result switches activePageId to Page 2

behaviour: Verify multi-page localStorage persistence, multi-page collaboration reconciliation with per-user viewport isolation, deleted-page element tombstoning against stale peer copies, and E2EE Firebase page encryption with legacy fallback.
rules: 1. Test AC-8 part 1 (localStorage persistence): create multiple pages with distinct elements and viewports, save via LocalData.save (and LocalData.flushSave) or clearAppStateForLocalStorage / importFromLocalStorage, and assert that importing from localStorage and restoring preserves all pages, their elements, activePageId, and pageViewports.

2. Test AC-8 part 2 (collaboration reconciliation and viewport isolation): verify reconcileElements and Collab remote scene updates merge elements and page list updates across multiple pages from remote peers while preserving the local user's independent activePageId and viewport (scrollX, scrollY, zoom), and gracefully fall back to a remaining valid page if a remote update deletes the local user's active page.

3. Test deleted-page tombstone reconciliation (NFR-3 / AC-8): create elements on Page 2, delete Page 2 via deletePage / scene.deletePageElements, assert Page 2's elements remain in getAllSceneElementsIncludingDeleted() as tombstones (isDeleted: true) with incremented version, and verify that reconcileElements against a peer's stale copy (where the Page 2 elements still have isDeleted: false and the pre-deletion version) keeps the deleted page's elements tombstoned (isDeleted: true) so they do not come back.

4. Test Firebase E2EE page list encryption/decryption and legacy fallback: verify saving to and loading from Firebase encrypts pages together with elements inside ciphertext (with no plaintext pages field on the stored Firestore document) and restores __pages on decrypt while legacy documents whose decrypted payload is a plain elements array without pages still load cleanly.

style_from.reason: Follow excalidraw-app Vitest test imports and structure.

uses.reason: Use LocalData.save and LocalData.flushSave for testing localStorage persistence.
Use importFromLocalStorage to verify persisted multi-page state and elements.

tests.name: AC-8.1: persists and restores all pages, elements, activePageId, and pageViewports in localStorage
tests.given: A multi-page drawing saved via LocalData and flushed to localStorage
tests.expect: importFromLocalStorage and restore return all pages, their elements, activePageId, and pageViewports intact

tests.name: AC-8.2: reconciles elements and page list across multiple pages in collaboration while keeping local viewport isolated
tests.given: Local user on Page 1 with custom scrollX/scrollY/zoom and remote collaborator updates on Page 1 and Page 2 (including remote page deletion)
tests.expect: reconcileElements and Collab merge remote elements and pages across all pages without overwriting local scrollX/scrollY/zoom, and switch to a valid remaining page if the active page is deleted remotely

tests.name: AC-8.3: tombstones deleted page elements with version bump so they stay deleted after reconciling with a peer's stale copy
tests.given: Elements created on Page 2, Page 2 deleted locally, and a remote peer holding a stale pre-deletion copy where Page 2 elements have isDeleted: false
tests.expect: deletePageElements marks Page 2 elements isDeleted: true with bumped version via newElementWith, and reconcileElements against the peer's stale copy preserves isDeleted: true

tests.name: AC-8.4: encrypts pages inside FirebaseStoredScene ciphertext and loads both multi-page and legacy single-page documents
tests.given: A multi-page scene saved via saveToFirebase and a legacy FirebaseStoredScene whose ciphertext decrypts to a plain elements array
tests.expect: The Firestore document stores only sceneVersion, ciphertext, and iv (no plaintext pages), loadFromFirebase decrypts elements with __pages attached for multi-page scenes, and legacy documents without pages load cleanly
